original_test_intent: Verify lower-GPUBB and upper-GPUBB FPGA firmware versions, plus the explicitly listed BMC/BIOS companion values, against approved before/after checkpoints and package targets.
original_method: Use documented WebUI and read-only vendor raw queries for the mapped components, validate response encoding and compare same-SUT before/after values after any separately governed firmware operation.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the lower/upper FPGA mapping, command schema and manifest and separately governs flashing; an operator verifies same-SUT checkpoints while automation performs only approved reads.
required_inputs: Exact read-only commands and response layout
Target manifest and protected before/after checkpoints
safety_requirements: Do not load a GPU driver or create heat for a version read
Do not flash, reset, power-cycle or clear logs
Verify same-SUT identity and lower/upper mapping
Stop on malformed or mismatched responses
Use separately approved recovery for flashing
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Run only approved read-only version queries
Validate completion, response length, encoding and component association
Compare lower/upper and confirmed companion values with checkpoints and manifest
Report without workload, flashing or verdict
engineer_actions: Supply mapping, vendor commands, decoder and target builds
Provide separate flash/recovery evidence when applicable

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable: TEMP_OCP workload and sensor output belong to duplicate row 773 and cannot establish FPGA firmware versions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve placeholders to approved read-only version requests and reviewed decoders; never add thermal workload or firmware mutation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Lower/upper FPGA checks, listed companions, before/after criterion, Script and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a lower/upper component matrix with raw response, completion, decoder version, decoded build and target comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes unrelated thermal stimulus and isolates observation from flashing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; both GPUBB FPGA instances remain mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong mapping can swap evidence; an external FPGA flash may impair GPU-board management or recovery.

project_override_considerations: A project may use equivalent supported UI/API fields and define companion scope, but must retain separate lower/upper identity, document equivalence and record any omitted named field.
expected_evidence: Raw and decoded before/after FPGA values
No-workload/no-mutation proof and no hardware PASS claim

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The FPGA item and lower/upper procedure are aligned; BMC/BIOS are additional companion values rather than contradictory behavior. Duplicate thermal row 773 is isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mapping, commands, decoder, manifest and checkpoints are finite package inputs; read-only verification is feasible after they are supplied.

review_improvement: Rejects a copied thermal workload, restores the two FPGA identities and prevents placeholder raw or flash execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: DeepSeek's PARTIAL label is directionally cautious but its method cannot answer the case. The needed artifacts are finite vendor inputs, and the resulting observation is read-only, so REQUIRES remains correct with a completely revised execution scope.
